scope.summary: The old target requires an update: a one-byte input causes its producer to read beyond the supplied input before compression. The supplied evidence does not establish full build and change-group sufficiency.

input.reason: For a one-byte input, LZ4_compressBound returns 17. The producer records 17 bytes for the one-byte pointer, and preference generation reads from data + 13.

blockers.requirement: Initialize the producer with the actual number of bytes available from the fuzz input.
blockers.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput calls LZ4_compressBound(size), stores that result in the producer, then generates frame preferences through frameInfo, range32, and retrieve32.
blockers.failure_condition: With a one-byte input, the producer records size 17 and retrieve32 reads data[13], beyond the supplied input.
blockers.alternative_paths: Preference generation occurs before the frame operation for this input; later compression errors or cleanup cannot avoid the read.
